nodes.description: Ownership address state variable of the Owned contract; written in the constructor, acceptOwnership and read in onlyOwner.
Pending owner address; set by transferOwnership and consumed/zeroed by acceptOwnership.
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.

Total token supply, set in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Token ticker string set in the constructor.

Token decimals value set in the constructor.
Owned() constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender (unprotected initial ownership assignment).
onlyOwner function that stages a new ownership address into newOwner.
Anyone may call; requires msg.sender == newOwner, then rotates owner and clears newOwner.
Shih() constructor; mints the whole supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
constant function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked subtraction.
constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd then emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using the spender's allowance; uses safeSub/safeAdd.
constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance and then calls the spender contract's receiveApproval; external callback after state write.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts, refusing ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function issuing an external ERC20 transfer on an arbitrary tokenAddress.
Checked addition helper returning a+b guarded by require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction helper returning a-b guarded by require(b <= a).
Checked multiplication helper returning a*b guarded by overflow require.
Checked division helper returning a/b guarded by require(b > 0).
msg.sender - caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance and allowance keying, and forwarded to external callees.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner directly from caller-controlled msg.sender.

acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before rotating ownership.
transfer debits and credits using msg.sender as the source account key.

approveAndCall keys allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.

owner state variable is written from msg.sender in the constructor.
transferOwnership writes the staged newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
